By Mich aa Ron ell at10:07am, May18,202
RESOLUTION NO.
DISCHARGE UN COLLECTIBLE DEBTS IN THE AMOUNT OF
S16,953.97PURSUANT TOWYO.STAT.S16-4-502."
WHEREAS, Wyo. Stat.  16-4-502 provides for discharge of un collectible debts upon
proper certification to the Governing Body; and
WHEREAS, the City Treasurer has prepared the required certification for un collectible
debts on the City's books, a copy of which is attached to and incorporated as part of this
Resolution; and
WHEREAS, the debts have been revicewed by the appropriate City staff and collection
efforts have failed; and
WHEREAS, the City desires to remove the un collectible debts from its books as
expediently as possible.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the City Treasurer is authorized to discharge the un collectible
debts in the amount of $16,953.97 from its books.
THIS RESOLUTION shall be in full force and effect from the after its passage in
accordance with the laws of the State of Wyoming.
PRESENTED, READ, AND ADOPTED this 
dayof
2021.
Patrick Collins, Mayor
(SEAL)
Attest:
Kristina F. Jones, City Clerk
